entities.name: Feminism (Second Wave)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The second wave of feminism (1960s–1980s) expanded beyond suffrage to address workplace discrimination, reproductive rights, sexual violence, and cultural sexism. Intellectually grounded by de Beauvoir and Betty Friedan, it achieved transformative legal reforms.
